name: grant-store-initialization
goal: Initialize grant store public and owner entries without circular constant reads

evidence: Moving d1GrantStore behind a forwarding facade left ERASE and EXPIRE_GRANTS in that facade. Owner SQL constants read ERASE before module initialization; SQL tests fail and Hub build reports a ReferenceError.

The existing store contract checks real SQLite revocation and exposed invalid SQL after relocation. Add native cold imports of both public and owner entries to the same standardized adapter suite so module initialization is proved directly.
Committed standard adapter suite 922e3a15 reproduces the circular initialization from both public and owner entries and fails real SQLite revocation assertions.

Place SQL constants with their initialized owner implementation; retain explicit public forwarding exports. The native cold-entry cases and real SQLite grant contract guard initialization and behavior together.
SQL constants are initialized in the owner module before SQL statements are constructed. The public module forwards the same exported names and no implementation imports back from its facade.
